Windows 11 25H2 (build 26200) no longer ships the PowerShell 2.0 optional feature. DISM rejects the feature name (0x800f080c), so Dism[MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root] fails instead of reporting it absent. The STIG OVAL also requires the Win32_OptionalFeature object to exist with InstallState 2, so SCC reports the rule as a finding on 25H2 regardless of configuration.
